blurb: Knot Bad Massage offers customized massage sessions tailored to individual needs, with options including cupping, hot stone, prenatal, deep tissue, sports, lymphatic drainage, and stretching. Prenatal massages are available after the first trimester with physician clearance. Childcare is available by arrangement for massage or float sessions.
